implementation: Migration 113 and PostgreSQL migration 014 persist one optimistic-concurrency profile document per account and optional server scope.
The service requires current membership for server-scoped owner writes and both viewer and target membership for server-scoped public reads.
Public reads enforce the target account profile-audience policy and strip hidden manual links.
The model bounds document, widget, game-list and link sizes; rejects duplicate identifiers, unknown widget types, credential-bearing URLs and non-HTTP(S) schemes.

The settings editor provides responsive customization, preview and summary columns, global/current-server switching, board/activity/wishlist tabs, two-color theme editing, self-reported activity, widget add/edit/order/remove and manual link visibility.
Member profile cards fetch authorized showcase data and label outbound links as user-provided; no OAuth or verified-account claim is made.
Animated GIF profile banners are decoded under frame, pixel, time and output-size budgets; a static poster is stored separately and reduced-motion viewers always receive the poster.
Member cards continue to render real granted badges, persisted account creation time and the current authorized server member identity without seeding reference data.

verification.command: go test -c . && go test -c ./models && go test -c ./repository && go test -c ./services && go test -c ./handlers

limitations: New Go test executables cannot be executed on this Windows host because Application Control blocks newly linked binaries; compilation is not recorded as runtime acceptance.
Independent-client, installed-Windows, keyboard, screen-reader and responsive visual acceptance remain open.
Animated banner server runtime, real badge/server-identity, independent-client and installed-Windows acceptance remain open.
